cards.title: Quint toolchain + ITF trace replay against the reducer
cards.body:
- `spec/quint/` with `quint` pinned via npx.
- `npm run spec` (local only, never in CI) runs `quint typecheck`, a bounded `quint run` with invariants and witnesses, then the ITF replay test.
- Add a vitest that loads ITF traces (`quint run --out-itf`) and replays each step into `worker/src/session-actor/reducer.ts`, asserting the same abstract state. Excluded from the default vitest run; `npm run spec` sets `SCOTTY_SPEC=1` to include it.
- Proof: `npm run spec` exits non-zero on a seeded model violation and on a seeded reducer divergence. Quint is a local design tool; it does not run in CI.

log.note: Done (uncommitted, branch m-00/quint-replay): spec/quint/session_lease.qnt (Create/Vaporize walk, preemption, deadline/failure, stale redelivery, revision fences; invariants singleLease/revisionStep/leaseFresh; 6 witnesses as vacuity guard), scripts/spec.mjs wired into npm run check, quint 0.32.0 pinned with --backend typescript (rust backend downloads unpinned binary), worker/test/session-actor/session-lease.replay.test.ts replays 200 ITF traces into decide() with zero divergence. Seeded proofs: reducer mutation fails replay; model mutation fails npm run spec. Open: user OK on -78 line reducer.test.ts trim; commit/PR split for board files. Next (M-01): extend model with Checkpoint/Sleep/Resume/unknown outcomes, then shrink reducer.test.ts further.

Scope grew per the user's direction (trim aggressively, no god modules). reducer.ts (1082 lines) split into session-actor/reducer/ (decide.ts is the fence and dispatch; admission/progress/settlement/activity/recovery; validity; plus the moved pure core authority/input/decision/transition/control/backup). Checked as a pure move: 81 definitions unchanged. A no-restricted-imports override keeps reducer/ pure, proven with a temporary violating import. transitions/recovery.ts moved into reducer/. All checks green, 147 tests pass. reducer.test.ts -78 lines covered by replay (user approved). In progress: a luna audit of all worker/test/session-actor tests (rubric: keep only e2e and state-breaking regression tests), then sol deletes and consolidates fixtures into worker/test/support/session-actor.ts. Filed C-11 (session/ + session-actor/ merge) and C-12 (audit of the rest of the suite). Still uncommitted on m-00/quint-replay.

HANDOFF (fresh session). PR PLAN: stacked PRs, all merged at the end. PR1 = m-00/quint-replay (Quint + replay + reducer split into session-actor/reducer/ + boundary lint), on top of main. Later PRs branch from the previous one (m-00/test-audit from m-00/quint-replay, etc.); open each with gh pr create --base <parent branch>; merge bottom-up, retargeting to main as each lands. Do not squash in a way that breaks the stack. BLOCKERS before opening PR1 (astra high review, work/m-00/astra-review.md, 4 confirmed by repro): (1) replay copies attempt/deadlineAt from reducer output, so corrupting them passes; track expected attempt/deadline from admission independently and compare. (2) the reachesStaleRedelivery witness also matches a duplicate Vaporize (474/500 traces with redeliver disabled); key it on the action or an explicit redelivery flag, and assert action and witness coverage over the replayed traces themselves. (3) no timeout on spawnSync in worker/test/support/quint.ts or on the spec.mjs child. (4) FORCE_COLOR=1 makes a passing npm run spec exit 1; set NO_COLOR in the child env and strip ANSI. (5) the reducer no-restricted-imports override only blocks ../**; add an allowlist that also bans node:*, cloudflare:*, @cloudflare/*, bare packages other than effect. (6) restore the deadline-after-repeated-UnknownProviderOutcome assertion in reducer.test.ts (unknown outcomes are not modeled). Also: singleLease/revisionStep are true by construction; consider replacing them with an invariant that can actually fail. NEXT PR (stacked): session-actor test cull. The luna draft at work/m-00/session-actor-test-audit.draft.md (delete 113/152) is NOT safe to apply: it claims replay covers UnknownProviderOutcome and forged current-revision fences (false), it counts the env-gated deployed canary as CI coverage (it is not), and it drops credential/prompt scrubbing, hard-cap, and chunked-storage tests as low-value. Verify every covered-by claim by reading the cited test before deleting; keep AGENTS.md invariant tests unless CI-run coverage is proven; then consolidate fixtures into worker/test/support/session-actor.ts (2 hardCap variants suffice). work/ is gitignored and local only.

SUPERSEDES the HANDOFF blocker list. Quint is local only (user direction): removed npm run spec from npm run check; vitest.config.ts excludes **/*.replay.test.ts unless SCOTTY_SPEC=1; scripts/spec.mjs runs the replay after the model checks. Triaged blockers before PR1, reduced to: (a) restore the deadline-after-repeated-UnknownProviderOutcome test in reducer.test.ts; (b) key reachesStaleRedelivery on a lastAction variable so a duplicate Vaporize cannot satisfy it; (c) delete the singleLease/revisionStep invariants, which hold by construction. Dropped as busy work: attempt/deadlineAt replay tracking (not modeled; M-01), spawn timeouts and FORCE_COLOR (local tool only), import allowlist widening (hypothetical).

cards.title: Session lifecycle model (lease, fences, stale results, Failed exits)
Create idempotency model
cards.body:
- Covers CLI key lifecycle × server outcomes (committed, failed, ambiguous, vaporized) × process restarts.
- Assert that a retry after a definitive failure creates a new session, and that an ambiguous outcome never duplicates one.
- Must find: R-01.

cards.title: Projection convergence model
cards.body:
- Covers authority transitions × projection writes that may fail × list reads × UI caches.
- Assert: once authority is `Gone`, the session is eventually never listed; the list never shows a state older than one committed revision.

cards.title: Sidecar turn / checkpoint / save model
cards.body:
- Actions: admit, steer, interrupt, checkpoint export, sleep save, stop and restore, with generation, thread and turn identity.
- Assert that checkpoint never interrupts, and that idempotent replay never double-admits a turn.

cards.title: Failed is a dead end → durable recovery operation
cards.body:
- **Problem:**
  - `Failed{actionable:boolean, backup|null}` (`session-actor/authority.ts:140-148`).
  - Resume admits only `actionable` failures (`reducer.ts:370-377`) and Create rejects any existing authority, so Vaporize is the only exit.
  - `backup` and `wakeSource` are redundant and need equality checks (`reducer.ts:200-217`).
  - Live: `c31ef4f2a9e6`.
- **Root fix:** `Failed` carries a typed `recovery: ResumeFrom(backup) | Recreate(workspace spec) | Terminal(reason)`, recorded when the failure is committed.
  - `Recreate` gives setup failures a real retry path that keeps the session ID.
  - Remove the boolean and the redundant wake source.
- **Proof:** a session-harness test and a deployed test covering create clone failure → `Failed(Recreate)` → retry → `Warm`, and sleep failure → `Failed(ResumeFrom)` → resume.
- **Deps:** M-01.

cards.title: Server-owned create idempotency (CLI pending-up poisoning)
cards.body:
- **Problem:**
  - The CLI keys `POST /api/sessions` with a local pending-up file keyed by `sha256([host, body])`, with a 24-hour TTL (`cli/src/dependencies.ts:222-240`).
  - A non-conflict failure returns without clearing it (`:327`). The only recovery path is a regex over the conflict message (`conflictSessionId`, cc5bf74).
  - Live repro: a clone failure during a rollout made every retry reuse the same session ID `c31ef4f2a9e6`. A new title was the only workaround.
- **Root fix:** the server records each idempotency key as `in_progress | committed(sessionId) | failed(code)` and returns it as a typed response.
  - The CLI reuses the key only while the outcome is ambiguous (transport failure or `in_progress`).
  - It clears the key on a definitive `failed` result.
- **Delete:** `conflictSessionId` and the message-regex path; any local key that outlives a definitive answer.
- **Proof:** a deployed test that forces a create failure (a bad repo), then retries from a fresh process and gets a new session. Also: a transport drop plus retry returns the same session.
- **Deps:** M-03.

cards.title: Authoritative session list; Gone is never listed
cards.body:
- **Problem:**
  - `GET /api/sessions` reads the KV projection (`worker/src/index.ts:939-957`), and KV writes are best-effort (`session/projection.ts:57`).
  - Vaporize's Gone fast paths return before the projection is removed (`session/object.ts:3703-3710`).
  - The UI compensates with correction caches and suppression sets (`ui/src/data/session-catalog-controller.ts:68-204`).
  - Observed live: `scotty list` shows vaporized sessions.
- **Root fix:** each committed actor transition emits its projection through a durable outbox that retries until acked. This includes `Gone`, which deletes the projection.
  - **Decision to record first:** keep KV and repair via the outbox, or move to an installation-scoped session index DO. Leaning KV + outbox, since it keeps list reads cheap.
- **Delete:**
  - the UI correction and suppression sets;
  - actor-versus-projection merging;
  - the best-effort publish helpers.
- **Proof:** deployed test where vaporize, with a projection write fault injected, eventually leaves the session out of both `scotty list` and `/api/sessions`. Plus a browser check that the row disappears.
- **Deps:** M-04. It also unblocks D-08.

cards.title: Checkpoint must not interrupt a running turn
cards.body:
- **Problem:** there are two paths.
  - Sidecar `save` interrupts a running turn, then stops the host (`worker/src/agent/sidecar/runtime.ts:441-460`).
  - The shared quiesce path POSTs `/quiesce` and then SIGTERMs Pi (`session-actor/transitions/backup-lifecycle-sandbox.ts:336-358`, `sandbox/auth.ts:757-788`).

  Checkpoint and sleep share both paths. `worker/test/agent/codex/runtime.test.ts:1006-1048` codifies the interruption as correct behavior.

- **Root fix:** split the agent contract into `export` (a consistent snapshot, non-disruptive, with a receipt tied to generation, thread and backup) and `quiesceAndStop` (sleep only).
  - Adapters declare their checkpoint capability. An agent that can't export mid-turn makes checkpoint wait for the turn, bounded, or return a typed `busy` outcome. It never interrupts silently.
- **Delete:** the `save → interrupt` path and the test that codifies it.
- **Proof:** deployed test with Codex and Claude: start a long turn, checkpoint, then assert the turn completes and the transcript survives a resume.
- **Deps:** M-06; interacts with R-05.

cards.title: Delete legacy compat paths
Cull the 7 dead unit-test files
Direction (owner decision)
cards.body: **Acceptance:** Recorded in `DESIGN.md`: dark-only vs. adding light; brand identity (the mark, hero and wordmark as one system); density; reference products. Everything else follows from it.

cards.title: Hard-cap timing model
cards.body:
- Covers drain, force and deadline; turn activity `active|idle|unknown`; early, dropped and duplicate alarms; per-phase durations.
- Assert that at the deadline the state is `Sleeping` with a confirmed backup, or `Failed(hard_cap_elapsed)` with the prior backup kept. The force point must always leave the sleep budget.
- Must find: the 75-second reserve on a 5-minute cap (fixed as a bandaid in 3be0300).

cards.title: Provider outcome / late completion model
cards.body:
- Covers create, backup, restore and destroy with `unknown` outcomes, late completion after timeout, and a retry with the same op ID.
- Assert: no completion without confirmed evidence; no orphaned owned resources after `Gone`.

cards.title: Auth ownership model (replaces the test-only machine)
cards.body:
- Covers owner, clients, pairing, transfer, recovery and revocation.
- Replaces `worker/test/auth/auth-ownership-machine.test.ts`.

cards.title: Deploy-run receipt model
cards.body:
- States: plan → approve → apply-ack → rollout observations, plus timeout and retry.
- Assert: an apply that may have succeeded is never reported as simply "failed"; drift after approval blocks the apply.

cards.title: Hatch + Evidence model
cards.body:
- Covers desired/observed/exposure/cleanup × generation/epoch × delayed completion.
- Assert: a closed or Gone Hatch never becomes exposed, and no available artifact points at a missing object.

cards.title: One persisted hard-cap budget policy; drain policy moves into the actor
Actor-owned wake scheduling; the host only delivers
cards.body:
- **Problem:**
  - Alarm policy is spread across the host: callback dedupe, overdue repair, and SQL scans of Container's internal scheduler table because `listSchedules` truncates (`object.ts:3358-3412`).
  - The 60-second retry-then-log path leaves a consumed alarm with no successor (`object.ts:6482-6499`).
  - Callback names are passed as `string`.
- **Root fix:** every actor commit returns a typed `nextWake` set, which the host persists and delivers through one alarm adapter with durable schedule state and repair on the next DO activation. Callbacks are a closed union.
- **Delete:** per-callback retry variants, the log-and-swallow path, and duplicated fence matching in the host.
- **Proof:** a harness test with injected schedule failures and DO restarts, where every wake eventually fires. Plus a deployed canary checking alarm delivery across eviction.
- **Deps:** M-01, M-02.

cards.title: SandboxProvider contract + durable operation IDs (runner prerequisite)
cards.body:
- **Problem:**
  - `SandboxRuntime` is an optional Cloudflare capability bag with SDK types (`sandbox/runtime.ts:1-36`).
  - Actor transitions check `provider === cloudflare` (`backup-lifecycle-sandbox.ts:1323`, `create-sandbox.ts:178`).
  - The runner protocol has no backup or restore, and no `unknown` outcome (`protocol/runner/runner.ts:30,239-255`).
  - The backup SDK promise can't be cancelled (`backups/store.ts:53-83`).
  - Idempotent backup relies on metadata and size, not a digest (`patches/@cloudflare+sandbox+0.12.9.patch:50-122`).
- **Root fix:**
  - A `SandboxProvider` service exposes `create | exec | backup | restore | destroy | inspect`, each keyed by a durable op ID, returning `Confirmed | Rejected | Unknown`. Reconciliation goes through `inspect` before any retry.
  - The Cloudflare adapter owns the SDK types, `stop`/`destroy`, ports and `localBucket`.
  - Backup becomes a Scotty-owned write-once R2 object with a digest and a tombstone.
- **Delete:** provider checks in transitions; the backup mutation parts of the sandbox patch.
- **Proof:** a shared provider contract test runs against the real Cloudflare adapter, deployed. The runner adapter must pass the same suite before runner create is enabled.
- **Deps:** M-05.

cards.title: Deploy run: applied ≠ settled; resumable observation
cards.body:
- **Problem:**
  - The CLI throws a settle timeout after `Apply.apply(plan)` has already succeeded (`cli/src/installation-deployment.ts:991-1019`). The release script does the same (`scripts/release/deploy-production.mjs:584-645`).
  - Release authorization checks the parsed plan text, then runs a fresh `alchemy deploy` (`:1152-1167`), so the apply isn't bound to the reviewed plan.
  - Runtime compatibility evidence is optional (`alchemy.run.ts:59-96`).
  - There are two watchers.
  - Live: every deploy of v0.3.29–31 reported `installation_deploy_failed`, yet the re-plan showed 0 changes.
- **Root fix:**
  - A persisted `DeployRun` goes `planned → applied(receipt) → settling → settled | failed | unknown`. `scotty deploy --resume` observes without reapplying. The exit code distinguishes "applied, not settled".
  - Both paths apply the exact reviewed plan.
  - Compat evidence is required for production.
- **Delete:** the duplicate release watcher and the text-plan authorization.
- **Proof:** a deployed CLI test with a short settle timeout: it reports `applied/unsettled`, then `--resume` reports `settled`.
- **Deps:** M-08.

cards.title: Credential grant is the sole capability record
cards.body:
- **Problem:**
  - The session side reconstructs grants (`session/object.ts:5895-5920`).
  - `issuedSessions` normalization is optional.
  - The plaintext `string` crosses RPC untyped (`credentials/object.ts:26-40`).
  - `egress/session.ts` carries a complexity suppression.
  - History: 21 commits, including 2 reverted migrations.
- **Root fix:**
  - The Registry DO grant is the only capability record, and the session holds a grant ID only.
  - Plaintext crosses RPC as a branded, redacted wrapper decoded at the egress edge.
  - Split egress into resolve, inject and proxy.
- **Delete:** reconstruction, normalization and compat shapes.
- **Proof:** full credential-sink e2e: a canary credential must be absent from container env, files, process args, logs, Git config, KV, R2, API responses and Alchemy state (extends `e2e/scripts/scan.mjs`). Rotation during a live session keeps working.

cards.title: Hatch: one tagged transition state + reconciler
cards.body:
- **Problem:**
  - Hatch state combines desired, observed, exposure, transition and cleanup (`hatch/contracts.ts:190-237`).
  - Cleanup retries every 5 s from several entry points (`object.ts:2010-2300`).
  - The v1 quota fields remain (`hatch/contracts.ts:145-163`).
  - Fixes so far: e16e241, fa5eb9c, ecda4aa, d2eae17.
- **Root fix:** one persisted tagged Hatch transition and a single reconciler for ensure, restore, close, failure, sleep and vaporize, keeping the generation and epoch fences.
- **Delete:** duplicated cleanup and retry branches; the v1 fields (with a reset note).
- **Proof:** deployed test covering Hatch ensure → handoff → HTTP and WebSocket traffic → sleep/resume → close, after which the port is unreachable.
- **Deps:** M-09, R-06.

cards.title: Evidence: actor-reconciled operation outbox
cards.body:
- **Problem:**
  - Job phase, preview exposure, R2 publication and deletion settle independently.
  - Deadline and retention callbacks are scattered (`object.ts:2697-2821`, `evidence/store.ts:627-1318`).
  - The store has more than 20 `as Effect.Effect<…>` casts.
  - The R2 body is cast (`evidence/artifact-store.ts:397`).
- **Root fix:** a durable operation log reconciled by the actor; R2 deletes stay represented until confirmed.
- **Proof:** deployed test: capture → final state → authenticated read → expiry or eviction → vaporize, after which the R2 objects are absent.
- **Deps:** M-09, R-06.

cards.title: Runtime CLI selection from a signed R2 catalog, not the GitHub API
cards.body:
- **Problem:**
  - Runtime selection scans GitHub Releases, up to 3 pages plus manifests (`runtime-cli/release-resolver.ts:333-443`).
  - Bandaids: the 10-minute freshness window and the outage/403 fallback (abcdade, `selection.ts:13,59-110`).
  - `sameRuntimeCompatibility` is duplicated.
- **Root fix:** release/deploy publishes a signed, compatibility-indexed catalog to installation R2, and the Worker selects from it and pins per image.
- **Delete:** GitHub discovery, pagination, the freshness window and the fallback.
- **Proof:** deployed create with GitHub unreachable still succeeds.

cards.title: CLI installation-state owner; a real doctor
cards.body:
- **Problem:**
  - init, recover and deploy each keep their own journal and file.
  - `doctor` is shallow (`cli/src/commands.ts:2606`).
  - There are 48 disables in `cli/src`, and an `ErrnoException` cast (`services.ts:371`).
- **Root fix:** one `InstallationState` service owns the local pointer and journals atomically. `doctor` checks auth, Worker version skew, rollout state, the credential presence of each provider, and alarm health.
- **Proof:** CLI e2e covering init → interrupted deploy → `doctor` pinpoints the problem → `deploy --resume`.

cards.title: Repo registry: async, versioned projection repair; one GitHub boundary
cards.body:
- **Problem:** listing does a synchronous full KV scan, delete and rebuild, and ignores repair failure (`index.ts:890-895,1910-1928`, `repos/projection.ts:158-190`). GitHub is verified again on every add path.
- **Root fix:** versioned projection repair through the same outbox as R-02, behind one GitHub metadata boundary with coalescing and rate-limit handling.
- **Proof:** deployed test where a stale projection is repaired without a full rebuild, and concurrent adds converge.

cards.title: All external JSON shapes live in protocol/**; one error envelope
One Worker host request adapter; drop the index.ts lint carve-out
cards.body:
- 19 `Effect.runPromise` calls in `worker/src/index.ts`, plus a six-rule file-wide carve-out (`.oxlintrc.json:116-130`).
- Error mapping is duplicated at `index.ts:246-272,1945-1983` and `auth/request.ts:171-203`.
- Target: routes are Effects run by one adapter, per `routing-effect-http`. Remove the carve-out and add `index.ts` to the strict override.

cards.title: Clock + IdGenerator services everywhere in the domain
cards.body:
- 49 `crypto.randomUUID()` calls and 7 `Date.now()` calls (`object.ts:5778`, `evidence/preview.ts`, `hatch/gateway.ts`, `auth/request.ts:132`) in domain code.
- Add an `IdGenerator` service with a test layer. Remaining direct calls must be adjacent host-boundary suppressions.

cards.title: Throwing parsers → Result; dedupe decoders; Schema.Unknown audit
cards.body:
- `session/contracts.ts:514-559` throws, with 19 suppressions.
- `decodeJsonValue` is duplicated (`worker/src/shared/json.ts`, `cli/src/schemas.ts:326`).
- 60 `Schema.Unknown`: audit and tighten each one.
- `buildResourceBundle` uses `Effect.promise` where it should use `tryPromise` (`sandbox/cloud-resources.ts:213-296`).

cards.title: Split session/object.ts (after R-06, R-10, R-11)
cards.body:
- Do this after R-06, R-10 and R-11, so it's a real ownership split rather than a file move.
- Target: host island (SDK callbacks, `#run`), alarm adapter, Hatch workflow, Evidence workflow, and projection publisher.

cards.title: Split the other oversized modules
cards.body:
- `cli/src/commands.ts` (3.1k) → per-command modules via `modeling-effect-cli`.
- `installation-deployment.ts` (1.7k) → plan, apply, observe and uninstall (with R-08).
- `backup-lifecycle-sandbox.ts` (1.4k) → per transition plus a shared backup adapter (with R-07).
- `codex/session.ts` (1.1k), `runner/transport.ts` (1.1k), `evidence/store.ts` (1.4k), `hatch/store.ts` (1.2k).
- Remove the `as Effect.Effect` casts.

cards.title: Busy-wait polling loops → Deferred / SubscriptionRef
cards.body:
- `while (...) yield* Effect.sleep("10 millis")` in sidecar save (`agent/sidecar/runtime.ts:443-447`), plus similar loops elsewhere (grep for them).
- Replace with `Deferred`, `SubscriptionRef` or `Queue`.

cards.title: Suppression audit: only host-boundary disables survive
cards.body:
- 136 disables across worker, cli and scripts: 51 `no-try-catch-or-throw`, 19 `no-effect-runtime-escape`, 16 `no-raw-wall-clock`, 9 `no-direct-do-storage`.
- Each survivor must be a documented native host contract.
- Complexity suppressions go; split the code instead.
- Add a lint budget check so the count only goes down.

cards.title: Convert the 64 unit-test files to e2e as their R cards land
knip export audit
cards.body: 337 unused exports and 172 unused types. Audit in batches per module during C-05/C-06, then turn on `knip` exports in the gate.

cards.title: Deployed e2e lane: busy/idle hard cap, Claude, full credential sink scan
Browser journey + visual regression lane
Executable tokens
cards.body: **Acceptance:** Semantic scales for color roles, type, spacing, radius, elevation, motion, focus and icon; `DESIGN.md` checked against the token source.

cards.title: Kill workspace.css
cards.body: **Acceptance:** Every selector migrated to component-owned StyleX variants; the file is deleted with no visual regression (E-02 baselines).

cards.title: Primitive set
cards.body: **Acceptance:** Button, IconButton, Input, Textarea, Field, Menu, Panel and Dialog, with consistent focus, hover, disabled, pending, error and touch states. No route-local lookalikes, e.g. the create button in `routes/sessions.tsx:81-95`.

cards.title: One palette everywhere
cards.body: **Acceptance:** Auth, evidence and showcase pages consume the same tokens (a generated CSS variables file).

cards.title: Type and density
cards.body: **Acceptance:** Named text roles (heading, body, control, meta) with a readable metadata floor; consistent density at each breakpoint.

cards.title: Iconography
cards.body: **Acceptance:** Named icon sizes and strokes; aligned optical baselines.

cards.title: Session header + lifecycle
cards.body: **Acceptance:** Actions show intent → pending → authoritative outcome (from the R-15 operation resource). The hard-cap countdown is always visible, accessible and fits mobile. The title, repo and branch stay discoverable on mobile (`workspace.css:201-215` hides them).

cards.title: Conversation
cards.body: **Acceptance:** Unified states (connecting, working, paused, reconnecting, unavailable, empty); one rich-block system for code, tables, Mermaid, diffs, tools and evidence, with contained overflow and copy; streaming Markdown without whole-document reparsing on each 750 ms poll (`Markdown.tsx:391-400`).

cards.title: Workbench contract
cards.body: **Acceptance:** Summary, diff, terminal, Hatch and evidence share a panel header, scrolling and empty/loading/error states. The terminal gets a reconnect action; diffs stay usable on mobile.

cards.title: First run
cards.body: **Acceptance:** locked → pair → recover → owner, with expiry, failure and retry states; ends on the session list.

cards.title: Home + create
cards.body: **Acceptance:** Clear first action and empty, loading, stale and retry states; create is one legible flow (repo, task, agent, submit progress) that submits once.

cards.title: Switcher + a11y
cards.body: **Acceptance:** ⌘K keyboard-only selection; mobile drawer focus; measured contrast; zoom/reflow; status announced, not signaled by color alone (the connection indicator is currently 1 px, `workspace.css:267-278`).

cards.title: Settings/admin
cards.body: **Acceptance:** Shared section, field and status patterns across settings, resources, providers, devices and stats; the devices copy-link action shows failures.

cards.title: Split UI modules
cards.body: **Acceptance:** Transport/polling vs. view in `LiveConversation`; per-tool workbench views; settings panes; UI data readers use `protocol/**` Schema (R-15).

cards.title: Performance at scale
cards.body: **Acceptance:** A long-history, long-stream browser scenario meets defined frame and input-latency budgets.

cards.title: v0.3.31 short-cap sleep reserve (bandaid; root fix is R-05)
cards.body: Shipped in PR #274. `HARD_CAP_SLEEP_RESERVE_MS` = 3 min. Root fix tracked in R-05.

cards.title: Merge session/ and session-actor/ into one session domain (reducer/, actor/, transitions/, host/); move configuration.ts out of the actor; break the public-view ↔ session/contracts cycle
cards.body:
- `session/` (host, the 6,968-line `object.ts`) and `session-actor/` are one domain split in two, with a cycle: `session-actor/public-view.ts` imports `session/contracts`, and `session/` imports half of `session-actor/`.
- Target: one `session/` directory with `reducer/` (the pure core, already isolated by M-00 and enforced by the `no-restricted-imports` override in `.oxlintrc.json`), `actor/` (actor, store, effect-runner, controllers, metadata), `transitions/` (executors) and `host/` (the Durable Object from C-05).
- Move `session-actor/configuration.ts` (the non-secret session config pinned at admission, read by `sandbox/auth.ts` and `agent/sidecar/client.ts`) to `session/` or `protocol/`, and drop the `!../configuration` exception from the reducer boundary rule.
- Pure move, with no re-exports for backward compatibility. Do it after C-05, so the host split has already happened.

cards.title: Test suite audit outside session-actor: keep e2e + state-breaking regression tests only; one fixture builder per domain
cards.body:
- Apply the M-00 test rubric to the rest of the suite, about 45k lines outside `worker/test/session-actor` (session 6.6k, agent 5.4k, cli/test 5.3k, integration 5.3k, …).
- Rubric: a test stays only if it names a concrete regression ("fails if <code change>") that no e2e, integration, replay or higher-layer test also catches. Delete tests that only echo their fixtures, restate the implementation line by line, or are covered elsewhere.
- Keep one fixture builder module per domain under `worker/test/support/`, with no per-file copies of `hardCap`/`session`/`readiness`.
- Work one directory per PR, with a luna audit, a review, then sol applying the deletions.
